title: wind_down
description: One stop of a workspace's loop finished winding down: the loop stopped taking new work, waited for the steps that were running (up to a cap), then stopped. Written once per stop, not for an issue. A retried write can repeat it: count one per (repo, device, requested_at).

requested_at.description: When the stop was asked for. With outcome off it equals stopped_at.

stopped_at.description: When the loop stopped. With outcome off it equals requested_at.

waited_ms.description: How long the stop waited for running steps, in milliseconds; 0 with outcome off.

cap_ms.description: The longest the stop was allowed to wait, in milliseconds.

outcome.description: How the wait ended: idle (no step was left running), cap (the wait cap ran out and the rest were cut), now (stopped at once, running steps cut), or off (wind-down is off: no wait).

running_at_request.description: How many steps were running when the stop was asked for.

running_at_request_keys.description: The loop keys of those steps (stepKey i<N>/l<life>/s<seq>/<step>/a<n>, or reviewKey i<N>/l<life>/review/<patch7>/r<round>/a<n>).

cut_at_stop.description: How many steps were still running, and cut, when the loop stopped.

cut_at_stop_keys.description: The loop keys of the cut steps, in the same form as running_at_request_keys. Lifted as a jsonb column so a cut step can be joined to its re-run.

trigger.description: What asked for the stop: restart-self, coder-stop, or null when not known.
